title: Margulis–Platonov normal-subgroup conjecture
exact_target: Are all noncentral normal subgroups of the rational points of a simply connected almost simple group obtained from open normal subgroups at its anisotropic finite places?

sources.citation: A. S. Rapinchuk, The congruence subgroup property for S-arithmetic subgroups of simple algebraic groups when S has positive Dirichlet density, arXiv:2603.27472v1 (29 March 2026).
